content.short: Tokenized private credit and pre-IPO equity, open to investors from $10.
content.description: Paimon Finance wraps funds from managers such as Blackstone, KKR and Franklin Templeton into regulated, audited token structures. Paimon Prime targets around 7% a year with daily liquidity, subject to terms, while its launchpad offers rounds in private companies. There are no six-figure minimums or accreditation checks. It calls itself the largest RWA project on BNB Chain and is backed by YZi Labs.
content.meta: Paimon Finance offers tokenized private credit targeting ~7% and private-company deals from $10, backed by YZi Labs.
